text: FIX `insert()`, `insertIfNotExists()`, `bulkInsert()`, `upsert()`, `bulkUpsert()` and `incrementalUpsert()` now accept `RxDocument` instances (also mixed with plain data in the bulk methods) and write the current data of the instance, same as `doc.toMutableJSON()`. Before, `insert()` and `insertIfNotExists()` allowed an `RxDocument` in their types but threw `DOC24` in dev-mode and stored a document without a primary key otherwise. Added testcases
